intro: Trigger a romance flag with an idol, and it’s a BAD END!
description:
You've just become the manager of the rookie idol group, "♡Melonchu♡"!
To make their debut concert a roaring success, dating any of the active idols is absolutely, 100% off-limits...!
And yet, romance flags keep popping up left and right, and the members' affection levels are already at MAX from the very start!
How on earth will you navigate this crisis?!
An otome game industry first (!?)—a slapstick rom-com where romance is strictly forbidden!

■ Story & Art (Scenario/Illustration): MikiMaki
【Game Features】
Fully voiced (excluding the protagonist)
Customizable protagonist name
8 unique endings
